summary: Wired graphStore.compact() into daemon.js periodic sweeps: one pass 5 min after boot (setTimeout) + daily (setInterval 24h), both unref'd/try-catch, compacting every known workspace store (new graphStore.allStores() export + state.graphStore, deduped by dir). Fixed a real data-loss bug found while verifying the contract: compact() deleted terminal nodes' JSONL files containing edge_added events, losing edges — checkpoint.json now also persists the full deduped edge set, loadGraph() replays cp.edges, and post-compaction appends fold on top of the checkpointed node state instead of an empty node. Added test/graph-store-compact.test.js (21 asserts: merged nodes/edges identical before vs after compaction, post-compact appends survive reload, second compaction lossless, idempotent no-op). All suites pass: graph-store (93), graph-store-compact (21), graph-store-integration (21), node --check daemon.js clean. NOT committed. Daemon restart required for compaction to go live (live daemon untouched).

description:
